_about: Matthew Poole (1624-1679), ejected Presbyterian minister: Annotations upon the Holy Bible (London, 1683-1685, 2 vols folio). Poole himself wrote the notes to Isaiah 58; the rest were completed after his death by Jackson, Collinges, Hurst, Cooper, Vinke, Mayo, Veal, Adams, Barker, Howe and others. Vol. I runs Genesis to Isaiah, vol. II Jeremiah to Revelation. Early English Books Online scans on the Internet Archive; raw OCR of 17th-century type (long s, ligatures), poor in places. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
